title: Free LLM API Hub provider status (/api/v1/status.json)
description: The freshness of every provider, keyed by slug. Contract v1: fields are only added within v1, so consumers must ignore fields they do not know; a field named here is never renamed, removed or retyped in v1.

version.description: The dataset release version (SemVer), the same as in every other file of /api/v1/.

generated.description: The date of the last dataset change, the same as in every other file of /api/v1/.

schema_version.description: The contract version of this file. It stays 1 for as long as /api/v1/ is served.

generated_at.description: The day every freshness state is graded at: the date of the last dataset change, never the build clock, so the file is byte-stable for a given dataset. Regrade last_verified against sla for your own today.

sla.description: The freshness SLA the states are graded by.

due_after_days.description: An entry verified more than this many days before generated_at is due for a re-check.

stale_after_days.description: An entry verified more than this many days before generated_at is stale: it has breached the SLA.

count.description: The number of providers; equals the number of keys of providers.

providers.description: One entry per provider of the dataset, keyed by its slug, in slug order.

last_verified.description: The day the entry was last verified against the provider's own docs, or null if never.

oldest_field_check.description: The oldest checked day among the entry's field_checks, or null when it has none.

freshness.description: fresh: verified at most sla.due_after_days before generated_at; due: up to sla.stale_after_days; stale: older; unverified: never verified.

free_now.description: true: verified, and the last probe did not report the free tier gone; false: the last probe reported tier-ended; null: not verified, so not confirmed.

last_change.description: The day of the entry's newest field-level change in the git history (the changes of changes.json, over the whole history, not only its last 12 weeks), or null when none is recorded.
